diagnosis: The gate failed because check C1 (which verifies coaching_status is set to "complete" based on PF1) failed in rollout 2, leaving C1 with only 3 passing rollouts. In rollout 2, all three decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF3) were properly revealed and cited in justification_fact_ids, so this is not a telepathy or never-revealed problem. The failure mode is ENCODING MISMATCH: the facilitator (A1) in rollout 2, influenced by A2's turn-5 clarification that the three observations cover only three consecutive meetings and not the full 60-day period, encoded coaching_status as "Completed with documented limitation — supporting evidence... covers three consecutive meetings, not the full 60-day period" instead of the unqualified "complete" that C1 expects. The model reasonably interpreted the limited evidence as warranting a qualified status, but C1 only accepts an unqualified "complete" value. All other checks (C2–C8, P1) passed in all four rollouts, and no rollout hit the turn cap.
